coupling: The earlier tree-maintenance commit duplicates a stream by copying its node, including its source-tree links. At that point index_tree_append always resets the links before insertion, so the copy remains safe. The later reverse-tree commit skips clearing the right link when prepending into a tree with one node, which is safe for freshly initialized streams and for the rightmost stream moved by concatenation. Together, lzma_index_dup prepends a copied source node with a stale right link into the one-node destination tree. After the source index is freed, public iteration of the duplicate follows that link and reads freed memory. The ownership failure is visible only by tracing node copying and link reset across both commits.
